title: day by day ({count})
query:
SELECT left("at", 10) AS day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "by" = 'the author') AS author, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "by" = 'the agent') AS agent
FROM turns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
lays_out: {day} - the author spoke {author} time(s), the agent {agent}

title: what the author said, the latest first ({count})
query:
SELECT id, left("at", 10) AS day, left(regexp_replace("text", '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 150) AS said
FROM turns WHERE "by" = 'the author' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT count(*) AS turns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "by" = 'the author') AS author, count(DISTINCT left("at", 10)) AS days,
       min(left("at", 10)) AS first, max(left("at", 10)) AS last FROM turns
lays_out: {turns} turns over {days} days, {first} to {last}; {author} of them the author's

query:
SELECT g.star, g.id, g.star || '/glimpses:' || g.id AS thing, try_cast(g."at" AS TIMESTAMP) AS done_at, g.summary
FROM glimpses g
WHERE try_cast(g."at" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e.from_table = 'glimpses' AND e.from_star = g.star AND e.from_id = g.id AND e.how = 'touches')
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e.from_table = 'glimpses' AND e.from_star = g.star AND e.from_id = g.id AND e.how = 'touches' AND e.to_table <> 'turns'))

title: done in {star} ({count})
query:
SELECT star, strftime(done_at, '%H:%M') AS at_time, summary, thing
FROM (SELECT *, min(done_at) OVER (PARTITION BY star) AS began FROM since) ORDER BY began, star, done_at

title: entered or changed: {kind} ({count})
query:
SELECT kind, thing, CASE WHEN says = '' THEN name ELSE says || ' (' || star || ')' END AS label
FROM touched
WHERE thing NOT IN (SELECT thing FROM signs_since) AND thing NOT IN (SELECT thing FROM learned_since)
ORDER BY kind, first_at, name

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM since) AS records, (SELECT count(DISTINCT star) FROM since) AS places,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM touched) AS things,
       CASE WHEN s.until IS NULL THEN 'nothing has been said since'
            ELSE 'until the author spoke again, ' || strftime(s.until, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') || ' UTC' END AS closed
FROM said s
lays_out: {records} record(s) of work followed in {places} place(s), entering or changing {things} thing(s) - {closed}

title: looking back - what was learned ({count})
query:
SELECT regexp_replace(r.learned, '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS learned, r.star, t.thing
FROM touched t JOIN reflections r ON r.star = t.star AND r.id = t.own
WHERE t.of_table = 'reflections' ORDER BY t.first_at, t.name

title: released since ({count})
query:
SELECT c.star, regexp_extract(c.says, 'release (.+?)( \(#[0-9]+\))?$', 1) AS what,
       strftime(try_cast(c."at" AS TIMESTAMP), '%H:%M') AS at_time, c.star || '/commits:' || c.id AS thing
FROM commits c, said s
WHERE c.says LIKE 'chore(main): release %' AND try_cast(c."at" AS TIMESTAMP) >= s.said_at
  AND (s.until IS NULL OR try_cast(c."at" AS TIMESTAMP) < s.until)
ORDER BY try_cast(c."at" AS TIMESTAMP)

WITH stood AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM spoken s
  WHERE s.thing = '{here}'
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM things h WHERE h.id = '{here}' AND h.of_table = 'turns' AND h.id = h.place || '/turns:' || s.id)
)
SELECT * FROM stood
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM spoken ORDER BY said_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stood)

title: what was said before, and how much followed each ({count})
query:
SELECT strftime(p.said_at, '%m-%d %H:%M') AS at_time,
       CASE WHEN length(p.words) > 110 THEN left(p.words, 110) || '...' ELSE p.words END AS words,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM done d WHERE d.done_at >= p.said_at AND d.done_at < p.until) AS records, p.thing
FROM spoken p, said s WHERE p.said_at < s.said_at ORDER BY p.said_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 6

title: what was said next ({count})
query:
SELECT strftime(n.said_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS at_time,
       CASE WHEN length(n.words) > 160 THEN left(n.words, 160) || '...' ELSE n.words END AS words, n.thing
FROM spoken n, said s WHERE n.said_at = s.until ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1

title: signs, {fate} ({count})
query:
WITH seen AS (
  SELECT thing, star, own, name, 'seen since' AS when_seen FROM touched WHERE of_table = 'problems'
), come AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c."from" AS thing, c.from_star AS star, c.from_id AS own, c.from_star || '/' || c.from_id AS name, 'seen before' AS when_seen
  FROM touched t JOIN edges c ON c.via = t.thing AND c.how = 'led to' AND c.from_table = 'problems'
  WHERE t.of_table = 'connections'
), signs_met AS (
  SELECT * FROM seen UNION ALL SELECT * FROM come WHERE thing NOT IN (SELECT thing FROM seen)
), fared AS (
  SELECT e.thing, e.star, e.when_seen, coalesce(nullif(t.says, ''), e.name) AS says,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unanswered u WHERE u.star = e.star AND u.id = e.own) THEN 'still showing'
              ELSE 'come to something' END AS fate,
         coalesce((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(nullif(w.says, ''), l.to_star || '/' || l.to_id), '; ')
                   FROM edges l LEFT JOIN things w ON w.id = l."to" WHERE l.how = 'led to' AND l."from" = e.thing), '') AS came
  FROM signs_met e LEFT JOIN things t ON t.id = e.thing
)
SELECT thing, star, fate, when_seen, says,
       CASE WHEN fate = 'still showing' OR came = '' THEN '' ELSE ' - it came to: ' || came END AS came_to
FROM fared ORDER BY CASE WHEN fate = 'still showing' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, star, says
SELECT d.* FROM done d, said s WHERE d.done_at >= s.said_at AND (s.until IS NULL OR d.done_at < s.until)

SELECT t.id, t.star, t.star || '/turns:' || t.id AS thing, try_cast(t."at" AS TIMESTAMP) AS said_at,
       lead(try_cast(t."at" AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (ORDER BY try_cast(t."at" AS TIMESTAMP), t.id) AS until,
       regexp_replace(t."text", '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS words
FROM turns t WHERE t."by" = 'the author' AND try_cast(t."at" AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL

SELECT e."to" AS thing, e.to_table AS of_table, e.to_star AS star, e.to_id AS own, e.to_star || '/' || e.to_id AS name,
       coalesce(k.entry, e.to_table) AS kind, coalesce(max(t.says), '') AS says, min(g.done_at) AS first_at
FROM since g JOIN edges e ON e.from_table = 'glimpses' AND e.from_star = g.star AND e.from_id = g.id AND e.how = 'touches' AND e.holds
LEFT JOIN (SELECT fills, min(entry) AS entry FROM lens_entries GROUP BY fills) k ON k.fills = e.to_table
LEFT JOIN things t ON t.id = e."to"
GROUP BY e."to", e.to_table, e.to_star, e.to_id, k.entry

title: toward what - the ideas the work was made standing on ({count})
query:
SELECT i.star, i.heading, count(DISTINCT g.thing) AS records, i.star || '/idea:' || i.id AS thing
FROM since g JOIN edges e ON e.from_table = 'glimpses' AND e.from_star = g.star AND e.from_id = g.id AND e.how = 'where' AND e.to_table = 'idea' AND e.holds
JOIN idea i ON i.star = e.to_star AND i.id = e.to_id
GROUP BY i.star, i.ord, i.heading, i.id ORDER BY records DESC, i.star, i.ord

title: what was said
query: SELECT strftime(said_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS at_time, words, thing FROM said
